title: Earlier today I teamed up with Matteo De Luca IKTA European Kickboxing Champion to record a series
author: PDeperson

comments.author: PDeperson
comments.body:
Earlier today I teamed up with Matteo De Luca  IKTA European Kickboxing Champion  to record a series of striking opening stances and combat-inspired motions, drawing influence from iconic fighting franchises like Tekken, Street Fighter, and Mortal Kombat ⚡
Premium 3D motion capture tailored for next-gen game production 🎮

Watch it here:
https://www.instagram.com/reel/DSVA7duguDG/?igsh=dXIxM3k2bXd4bzI5

#MotionCapture #Mocap #GameDev #GameDevelopment #FightingGames #3DArt #3DAnimation #GameAnimation #CharacterAnimation #VFX #DigitalHumans #UnrealEngine #Unity3D #IndieGameDev #GameArt #IKTA #Kickboxing #Tekken #StreetFighter #MortalKombat

comments.author: Revelation12Studios
comments.body: Nice. But why did you need a kickboxing champion to do this and not just record yourself?

replies.author: PDeperson
replies.body: Thanks, I could have, but I was sure he would do it better, don't you think? Would you like to try?
